title: World's biggest spirits maker pops 6% on $1 billion cost-cutting plan
summary_full: Diageo, whose brands include Johnnie Walker scotch whisky, Captain Morgan rum and Guinness stout, said costs relating to the savings program will amount to $1.2 billion.
